title: Rust parity: Rust send methods missing priority parameter
description: Python DatagramChannel.send_datagram() accepts priority kwarg. Rust send_coap_raw(), send_ipv6_raw() etc have no priority param - only queue_forward() at forwarding buffer level. Fix: add priority param to public send APIs.
close_reason: Fixed: Added Priority enum (Sos/Routing/Urgent/Normal/Bulk) to stack.rs matching Python tx_queue.Priority. Added priority parameter to send_ipv6_raw, send_ipv6_to, send_ipv6_to_route, send_coap_raw, send_coap_raw_to. Updated all callers in secure.rs, rpl_stack/transmit.rs, rpl_stack/receive.rs, and tests. RPL control traffic uses Priority::Routing, forwarded/app traffic uses Priority::Normal.
